name: Heel Slide
steps: Lie on your back with the working leg extended and its heel resting on a surface where it can slide.
Draw the heel toward your buttock until you reach a comfortable bend in the knee.
Slide the heel away to straighten the leg, continuing smoothly through this range before switching sides.
tips: Keep the kneecap facing upward so the leg does not roll out.
Keep your pelvis resting on the surface as the heel moves.
